limitations: Same continuous16-command sweep and32worlds per seed; three seeds are finite evidence.
0.10m discretization changes the sampled terrain; no fine-grid0.05m performance claim.
World base height on heightfields is not torso clearance; no plane-based clearance inference.
No matched flat re-evaluation or hardware validation of the Bumpy candidate.
Position-target slew was disabled in this experiment; a different deployed actuation contract requires new review.
decision: Do not promote. Aggregate failure count falls101to81 and horizontal error improves, but seed404 failures increase36to37, individual command failures increase, and standing torque/slip/yaw costs regress. All phases used zero-overflow0.10m grid; this does not validate the original0.05m grid or physical terrain performance.
